==Description==
'''Enchanted Forest''' is a [[Maps|map]] only available in private servers that takes place in a mystical forest.

'''Enchanted Forest''' has the [[All Paths]] modifier, which duplicates all enemies for each path with the exception of major bosses. It also increases {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} rewards by 10%.

==Design & Path==
'''Enchanted Forest''' takes place on multiple islands, which are split into islands with a blue flora and islands with a pink flora. Some islands are connected by wooden bridges. On the islands, multiple trees, bushes and rocks can be found. Lily pads can be seen, with glowing pink flowers. On one island, a giant tree can be found. This tree has a large metal platform, which can be accessed through a rope. On another island, a collapsed lighthouse can be found. On one of the main islands, there is a small stone statue with a humanoid that holds a sword.

The paths start at caves and end at a building, which appears to be an observatory. These paths merge near the middle of the map, near the stone statue.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Insane|Modifiers = 1.1|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*All enemies, except the major boss spawn twice on this map due to the [[All Paths]] modifier.
**The increased amount of enemies allows you to gain more cash by damaging enemies. The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can also generate more cash because of this.
*It is recommended to place your towers where the paths intersect.
**Do note that space is limited on this map, as the islands on which you can place your towers on are quite small. This means you may not want to use the [[Turret]], as it has a bigger placement footprint.
***The [[Military Base]] and [[Farm]] should also be placed far away from the area where you place down your DPS towers, as they will take up important space.
*As both parts merge at the intersection, area of effect towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be very useful here.
*This map has a high number of cliff spots, though they are far apart from each other.
**Cliff towers should generally be placed around the intersection, as it allows them to cover a lot of the path.
***The [[DJ Booth]] can allow your cliff towers to cover more path, which is especially helpful for cliff towers that are not placed in the middle of the map.

==Trivia==
*At the edge of the map is an island with a sword in a rock. The sword itself is made of stone, implying this is another sculpture.
*Multiple lanterns on the map are not suspended by anything, and are floating. They are not placed consistently so this is most likely a developer mistake.
